content: Kein na Eibol utuninji
Adam i ghenethaiya levo Ive, kaero i marabo na i ghamba nariye. Ive iŋa, “Giya Loi le thalavu e ghino na ya vaidiya ŋgama ghɨmoru.” Iya kaiwae i rena idae Kein.
Muyai amba te i ghambɨva Kein ghaghae, idae Eibol. Eibol iye va i mbanɨŋgiya sip na Kein i kaiwo e uma.
Mbaŋa umako i tara, Kein i mbana umako une vavana na i bigimena na le mwaewo weya Giya Loi.
Ko iyemaeŋge Eibol i mbana le sip virɨviva vavana na ghanjitabo vondɨvondɨ, na i vakatha le mwaewo. Giya Loi i worawa Eibol na le mwaewo e ghamwae,
ko Kein eŋge na le mwaewo mava i warari kaiwae. Iya kaiwae Kein ghare i gaithɨ laghɨye moli na ghamwae i undu.
Amba Giya Loi i dagewe, iŋa, “Buda kaiwae gharen i gaithɨ? Buda kaiwae nuwan i tharɨ?

Thoŋgo u vakatha kamwathɨ thovuye uŋa eŋge maane ya wovatha len vakathana? Ko thoŋgo ma u vakatha kamwathɨ thovuye tharɨ maiya vara evasiwanɨna; nuwaiya i ru e ghen, ko mbe ghen vara u njimbukikiŋge.”
Amba Kein i dage weya ghaghae Eibol iŋa, “Wou, ra wa e njamnjam bwaga.” Mbaŋa inanji gheko, Kein i unɨgha ghaghae Eibol na i tagavamare.
Amba Giya Loi i vaito Kein iŋa, “Ghagha Eibol aŋga inae?” I gonjoghawe iŋa, “Maa ya ghareghare. Ghino maa Eibol gharanjimbunjimbu.”
Giya Loi i dagewe iŋa, “Mo vakatha budakai? Wo u vandeŋeŋgo! Ghagha Eibol madɨbae i yawaru e thelauko tɨne na ghalɨŋae kaero i voro e ghino.

E mbaŋake iyake vuyowo i vana e vwatan, na maa tene u kaiwova e thelauna iyana, kaiwae kaero i muna ghaghana madɨbae, na raŋaeŋgeva me yoghatho na i wovoŋgu mbaŋa mo unɨghɨ. Ne iwaeŋge ya vambeleyathuŋge e thivathivake iyake na ya vakatha ghanji ghakaiwo i vuyowo moli.
Mbaŋa ne u kaiwo e thelauna, maane ghanɨŋga i mbuthuwe. Ghen ma tene e ghambaghambanɨva. Yambaneke laghɨye gharandeloŋga ghen.”
Kein i dage weya Giya Loi iŋa, “Vuyowoke iya u lithɨke e ghino i laghɨye moli na i kivwalaŋgo, maa valɨkaiwaŋgu ne ya ghataŋaghathɨ.
Noroke kaero u variyeyathuŋgo na ma valɨkaiwangu ya thuweŋge. Na tembe ŋgoreiyeva thelauke laghɨye gharaloŋgatakwe, na thela ne i loŋgavaidiŋgo ne i tagavamareŋgo.”

Ko iyemaeŋge Giya Loi i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ma valɨkaiwae. Thoŋgo lolo regha i tagavamareŋge ne modae i laghɨye kivwala mbaŋapirɨ na e vwataeova.” Amba Giya Loi i vakatha nono regha Kein e riwae na i giya vanuwovɨrɨ weŋgiya thavala ne thɨ vaidi na thava thɨ unɨghɨ.
Kein i roiteta Giya Loi, na i wa ve yaku e valɨvaŋga regha idae Nod, Iden valɨvaŋga i vorovoro.
Kein orumburumbuye
Mbaŋa gheviyeva e ghereiye Kein i ghe na levo i marabo, i ghamba narinji regha idae Inok. Amba i vatada ghemba laghɨye regha na nariyeko le ghaida.
Inok i ghambɨ weiye levo na narinji idae Irad, na Irad nariye Mehujael, Mehujael nariye Metuisela, na Metuisela nariye Lemeki.
Lemeki le ovo theunyiwo, eunda idae Ada na eunda idae Jila.
Ada nariye Jabal.
Amalaghɨniye va i yakukai vara e ŋgolo thɨ vakatha e thetheghan njimwanji na thɨ njimbukikiŋgiya sip. Ghaghae nasiyeniye va idae Jubol, iye va i mwadiwokai vara hap na igo.
Jila va i ghambɨva ŋgama ghɨmoru idae, Tubal-Kein, iye va i ŋambuŋambu brons na aiyan na i vakathaŋgiya kaiwo bigibiginiye. Tubal-Kein louye Naama.
Lemeki i dage weŋgiya le ovo iŋa,

content.text: Lemeki le ovo wo hu vandeŋe lo utuke.
Kaero ma tagavamare amala regha kaiwae me vawonamboyaoŋa riwaŋgu,
Thoŋgo Loi i lithɨ weya Kein gharatagavamare mbaŋapirɨ,
thoŋgo lolo regha i munje ne i tagavamareŋgo, ne ya lithɨwe mbaŋaepirɨ na mbaŋapirɨ na e vwataeva.”

content: Adam mbowo i ghenava weiye levo, i marabo na i ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru na Ive i rena idae Set, iŋa, “Loi i vatomwe e ghino na mbowo ya vaidiva ŋgama regha Eibol ghathɨghɨthɨghɨ, kaiwae Kein kaero va i tagavamare.”
Set vambe e nanariyeva, na va i rena idae Inos. Va e mbaŋako iyako na i ghaoko, gharɨgharɨ thɨ kururukai vara weya Giya Loi thɨŋa “Wo tarawe e ghen, Yawe.”

footnotes.text: Idake Kein ghaloŋwaloŋwa ŋgoreiye Hibru utu regha gharumwaru “rawo”.
Idake Yawe gharumwaru “Giya Loi”. Idake iyake Loi idae moli.
